title.en: Moon in Aries: movement as a reflection prompt

title.en: Moon in Taurus: noticing familiar comforts

title.en: Taurus rising: finding a workable pace

paragraphs.en: An additional body-role contrast: Venus’s topic can ask which details of the cup are enjoyable. Saturn’s topic can ask how much upkeep is manageable and when to stop. Enjoyment and maintaining something differ; a shared sign creates no duty to keep it forever.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者为了解一道食物的来历，比较两份不同地区的介绍，发现各自只覆盖部分传统。可以继续问来源，也可以暂缓结论。弓箭手意象给探索一个问题，不把旅行、知识或信念排名，也不让吸引人的叙述自动成为事实。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader compares two regional accounts of a food’s origins and finds that each covers only part of the tradition. Further source questions or suspended judgment are possible. The archer gives exploration a question without ranking travel, knowledge or belief or turning an appealing account into fact.

title.en: Sun in Sagittarius: deciding why the question matters

paragraphs.zh: 以“比较两份食物来历的介绍”为虚构例子，太阳角色可问：“为什么想了解这个问题，哪种表达真正代表目前的理解？”这是选择与表达的问题，不是从落点观察到的天生特质。
paragraphs.en: For a fictional comparison of two accounts of a food’s origins, the Sun-role question asks: “Why explore this question, and which expression represents the current understanding?” It concerns choice and expression, without observing an inborn trait from a placement.

title.en: Moon in Sagittarius: room for another view

paragraphs.zh: 以“比较两份食物来历的介绍”为虚构例子，月亮角色可问：“发现原有说法不完整时，需要先承认失望，还是愿意比较新解释？”答案来自当时体验与表达，不从星盘推定，也不把回答当作诊断。
paragraphs.en: For a fictional comparison of two accounts of a food’s origins, the Moon-role question asks: “When an earlier account proves incomplete, is acknowledging disappointment or considering another account wanted first?” Look to the experience and the person’s account, rather than deriving an answer from the chart or making a diagnosis.

title.en: Sagittarius rising: entering with a direction to explore
title.zh: 射手上升：带着想探索的方向进入

paragraphs.zh: 以“比较两份食物来历的介绍”为虚构例子，上升角色可问：“进入陌生主题时，怎样说明兴趣，同时询问材料实际能够回答什么？”这是进入情境的可选例子，不是对外貌或陌生人印象的测量。
paragraphs.en: For a fictional comparison of two accounts of a food’s origins, the rising-role question asks: “On entering an unfamiliar subject, how could interest be stated while asking what the material can actually answer?” This is an optional example of entering a setting, without measuring appearance or strangers’ impressions.

title.en: A larger picture still needs evidence
title.zh: 更大的图景仍需要证据

paragraphs.zh: 补充天体角色对照：木星主题可以问较大叙述包含什么假设；水星主题可以问怎样准确说明两份材料的差异。意义与表达不能互换，也不由射手落点证明乐观、诚实或必须追求宏大目的。

Meaning and expression differ; Sagittarius placements establish no optimism, honesty or obligation to pursue a grand purpose.

paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader sets aside twenty minutes for one shelf, defines that limited scope and allows stopping. Missing materials later lead to postponement. The sea-goat frames routes and resources without making persistence a duty or requiring completion before rest or support is deserved.

title.en: Moon in Capricorn: support does not need to be earned

paragraphs.en: An additional body-role contrast: Saturn’s topic can ask whether the scope is manageable. Venus’s topic can ask which objects are worth keeping. Responsibility and appreciation differ; Capricorn placements infer neither achievement nor finances nor how long a commitment must last.
